items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: He and I sat down to the table. And I opened my books.

ctx.x: And I had my books with me and I went down there you see. He and I sat down to the table. And I opened my books. He was going to give me so much money and I opened my books and told him. He say, hey you keep them books? I said, yes, I've been keeping books. And he told Zutty, he said, my goodness, he said we should have more wives like Margie. Margie is really taking care of your business. And I told him just how much he owed me.
